# trajectory reference frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:trajectoryReferenceFrame`](gmeow-trajectoryReferenceFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/trajectoryReferenceFrame>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The coordinate reference frame in which this trajectory's samples are expressed. Functional: a trajectory is expressed in exactly one frame; frame transformation is a solver concern ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Trajectory`](../classes/gmeow-Trajectory.md) -> [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:trajectoryReferenceFrame`](gmeow-trajectoryReferenceFrame.md) from [`gmeow:Trajectory`](../classes/gmeow-Trajectory.md) to [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md), [`gmeow:Trajectory`](../classes/gmeow-Trajectory.md), [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to declare the single frame in which a trajectory's samples are expressed; functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid omitting it and avoid asserting frame transforms as triples (solver-layer, [Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:trajectoryReferenceFrame`](gmeow-trajectoryReferenceFrame.md), a subproperty of [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md).

### Examples

- ex:path [`gmeow:trajectoryReferenceFrame`](gmeow-trajectoryReferenceFrame.md) ex:siteGrid.
